newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drs firms flattening yield curve in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drs firms flattening yield curve in late trade.

text.p: Ecu/drachma continued to strengthen on forex outflows and long implied drachma rates from forex forwards firmed 20 basis points, flattening the yield curve in late trade, dealers said.
"Implied drachma rates in long dates have firmed 20 basis points in late dealing, flattening the yield curve," the money market dealer at a foreign bank said.
The central bank drained overnight cash at 12.40 percent, but dealers said the market could easily turn short on forex outflows and an auction of state securities.
"Ecu/drachma firmed further as banks bought about 280 million ecus at the fiixng. Part of it relates to an ecu-linked bond that matured," said a forex bank dealer.
The mark was quoted at 158.10/20 drachmas from Thursday's 158.060 fix, the dollar at 243.81/91 drachmas from 243.400 and the Ecu at 303.89/99 from 304.500 drachmas.
